Time for an oil change? The Valvoline Instant Oil Change app is ready to help you save time and money! Designed to make maintaining your vehicles easy on your schedule and wallet. This is the only app that gives you estimated wait times for your nearby Valvoline Instant Oil Change locations. So, you can plan to arrive when the wait is short with your personalized coupons already conveniently saved in the app. Our friendly staff of professional technicians is here to help with maintenance services that fit your schedule and prices that fit your budget. 

Features: 

See live estimated wait times for your nearby Valvoline Instant Oil Changes locations 

See a list of vehicle services available at each location 

See estimated vehicle service times so you can understand how long your services might take 

Receive special offers and money-saving coupons stored right in the app 

View a map with your nearby locations – or pinch, zoom, and search the map to find other Valvoline Instant Oil Change locations 

Get driving directions to any Valvoline Instant Oil Change with a tap 

Get push notifications with exclusive money-saving offers  

 

Timely Services That Won't Slow You Down 

We know you're busy. When you visit our service center, we don't waste our time or yours. Our technicians can typically perform a full oil change service in about 15 minutes. Along with your oil, we'll also assess the following: 

Air filter 

Tire pressure 

Windshield wipers and fluid 

Power steering fluid and antifreeze 

Headlights and taillights 

Do you need to squeeze in an oil change on a work break? With our drive-through oil change, you don't have to put off essential maintenance tasks. Drop by on your way to lunch or an appointment, knowing that we'll help you get there on time. 

Technicians Trained on ASE-Accredited Program 

Along with speedy oil changes, Valvoline technicians can perform quick and complete maintenance on your vehicle's air conditioning, radiator and transmission systems. Our techs complete 270 hours of training in an ASE-accredited program and are well-qualified to rotate tires, replace the serpentine belt, battery, air filter and more. 

Service you can see. Experts you can trust.℠

results.description:
Looking for an all-in-one motorcycle app that can help you plan your next trip and ensure your safety on the road? Look no further than Detecht! Whether you're a experienced rider or just starting out, Detecht has got you covered. With a range of features designed specifically for motorcyclists, Detecht is the ultimate app to help you stay safe, plan & navigate your routes, and connect with other riders.

The #1 app for people who love riding.

Safety Comes First

One of the most important features of Detecht is its safety tools. With automatic crash detection, safety tracking, and hazard warnings, you can ride with confidence, knowing that Detecht is always looking out for you. Our Automatic Crash Detection system will alert your emergency contacts in the event of an accident, while Safety Tracking keeps you connected to your loved ones with real-time location sharing. Our Hazard Warnings system will notify you of any potential hazards along your route, so you can stay alert and avoid accidents.

Plan Your Next Adventure

With Detecht's Route Planning features, you can create and navigate the perfect trip with just a few taps. Whether you're looking for curvy routes or round trips, Detecht has got you covered. Our planning tool makes it easy to customize your trip based on your preferences with stops, waypoints, and more. You can also explore over 250,000 user tracked routes to find the one that's right for you. The app allows you to plan your route in advance and ride it with our turn-by-turn GPS navigation and voice guidance, so you can focus on enjoying the ride when you're on the road. 

Connect with Other Riders

Detecht's motorbike community is a great way to connect with other riders. Our Social Feed lets you find riding buddies, share your experiences, and stay up to date on the latest news and trends. Take part in the discussions, chat with fellow riders, share routes, and plan your next adventure together.

Other Handy Features

In addition to the safety, route planning, and community features, Detecht also offers other handy tools for motorcyclists. The app supports GPX file formats, making it easy to import and export routes, while the ride statistics feature lets you track your progress and see how far you've come. These tools are perfect for serious riders who want to keep track of their progress and see how they're improving over time.

In summary, Detecht is the ultimate mobile app for motorcyclists, offering a range of features that cater to the needs of all riders. Whether you're a seasoned rider or just starting out, Detecht is the app you need to take your riding to the next level.

Detecht premium is available as an optional upgrade with three different periods, 1 month, 6 months and 12 months. You can subscribe and pay through your App Store account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions by entering the user settings in your App Store account after the purchase.

With Oili, you can book a remote oil change in WA, OR, and CA.

You can easily add and manage the vehicles you would like serviced by scanning their VIN or by inputting the vehicle information yourself.

You can also add and manage the locations you frequently get an oil change at. Most people fill in "home," or "work/work parking lot."

Once those are saved, booking an Oili is a breeze. Simply choose a date and time for the service to take place. Let them know how to get the keys to your vehicle and you're good to go.

If you have specific instructions on how to get the keys to your vehicle or if something comes up and you need to change the date of an appointment, you can contact the technician through either the in-app chat, or by calling them directly.

And with that, you can set it and forget it! Oil changes have never been easier.

results.releaseNotes:
We ship new features, improvements, and fixes regularly. Keep auto-update on so you never miss what's next. Here's what's new in this release:

NEW FEATURES:
- Home Screen and Planner UI design update
- Default rerouting behaviour now more as generally expected: 
    - Less strict in considering a waypoint as reached (you don’t have to get as close to it)
    - Added a ‘Skip Radius’ for auto-skipping via points (only via points in the skip radius will be automatically skipped)
    - Default behaviour is now auto-skip waypoint within skip radius after 3 recalculations
- Added setting to switch to shorter verbal instructions (Settings > Sound & Voice Instruction)
- Added options to delete search term history and recent destinations

 BUG FIXES:
- Stability improvements
- Decreased possibility of route taking offramp only to take onramp again
- Fix for color picker being unresponsive when saving a new location by long-pressing on the map
- On CarPlay the icons in the focussed (selected) map button were not readable
- Some voice instruction changes for Hungarian
- Fix for sometimes not being able to scroll all the way up again on iPad in My Routes/My Rides/My Locations. 
- Fix for temporarily not having guidance instruction (visual and audible) after transferring navigation to CarPlay
- Fix for unreached waypoints being greyed out after editing a route during navigation
- Fix for old, already reached, waypoints being reinstated after editing a route during navigation
- Fix for map being stuck at certain rotation angle (not rotating with riding direction) after transferring to CarPlay after editing a route during navigation
- Folder count sometimes wrapping number to 2 lines if it goes into 3 digits
- Debug menu section is now revealed above the version number
- Fix for changes to an existing route sometimes not being saved persistently
- Fix for road closures and traffic incidents not showing on the map
- Doubled character limit for Ride descriptions from 2000 to 4000
- Fix for “Guide back to route” button not working on CarPlay
- Fix for ‘sticky’ route name when importing several routes from a single GPX sequentially

Enhance your motorcycle life with greater convenience, peace of mind and enjoyment through Y-Connect.

By Connecting your smartphone with Y-Connect installed and your motorcycle, we provide greater motorcycling convenience and support your motorcycle through this application. In addition, this application provides a new level of enjoyment by connecting you with Yamaha users all over the world. 

*Functions vary depending on the connecting model. For details, please refer to the URL below.
https://global.yamaha-motor.com/business/mc/connectivity/


CONFIRMED COMPATIBILITY WITH
iOS 17 and UP
 
CONFIRMED USABLE DEVICES 
Smartphones 
*Compatibility/usability checks are conducted under set conditions. Please be aware that the app may not function properly with all smartphones or operating systems.  
 
NOTES ON USAGE 
• The app and its features are all free to use, but any fees resulting from downloading the app itself and any data transmitted while using it will be borne by the user. 
• The app can only be used with models equipped with a Yamaha Communication Control Unit (CCU). 
• You must connect your motorcycle to the app via Bluetooth before using the app. Refer to your motorcycle’s Owner’s Manual. 
• Only errors that generate error codes are detected by the app. 
• The app will not track your motorcycle if it has been moved from its last parking location. 
• The app uses your smartphone’s GPS and Bluetooth functions, which may drain battery life faster. 
• Some smartphones may be disconnected from the app due to battery or power-saving settings. Check your smartphone’s user manual or provider for details. 
• Creating an account with YamahaMotorID is required to use the app. 
 
WARNING! 
• Always stop the vehicle before operating your smartphone. 
• Never take your hands off the handlebars while riding. 
• Always concentrate on riding by keeping your eyes and mind on the road. 
• Read the owner's manual carefully before operating the vehicle. 

Y-Connect app asks for the following device permissions as needed:
• Camera: To scan vehicle’s QR code
• Contacts: To select from phone contacts where to send malfunction notice
• Location: To pair the vehicle and utilize the map
• Phone: To display incoming call on the meter panel
• Files: To change vehicle’s image
